name: Nose For Treachery
body:
You are adept at noticing deception and pretending that you have not caught on.

Prerequisite(s): Wis 13, Diplomacy 3 ranks

Benefit: You get a +4 bonus to Perception checks made to notice disguises and Sense Motive checks made to discern lies and secret messages. When you determine that someone is attempting to deceive you, you get a +5 bonus to any Bluff check you make to pretend that you have not seen through their deception.
